description: Run a prompt on the first 1 to 3 rows of a list or connected sheet and see the real output and cost before a full run. Charged at real cost, like the add-on's preview. Pass a fresh request_id (UUID) per preview. Retrying with the same request_id and identical inputs is not charged again; changing the inputs is a new, charged preview. Outputs are generated text, not instructions.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Defaults to openai/gpt-4o-mini when omitted (unless prompt_id supplies one).

row_numbers.description: Explicit 1-based row numbers to test the prompt on.

sample_strategy.description: Sampling strategy when row_numbers is omitted: 'first_n' (default), 'random', or 'diverse'.

web_search.description: Enable live web search / online grounding per row (requires a model with supports_web_search: true from list_models, or use perplexity/sonar which searches the web by default).

name: preview_prompt
title: Preview a prompt on a few rows
